title: Hamas says it will study Trump Gaza plan, as Netanyahu warns Israel will ‘finish the job’ if deal rejected – Middle East crisis live
summary: Senior Hamas official says group will begin studying the proposals today, but it remains unclear when it will give a response What’s in Trump’s 20-point peace plan for Gaza? The Spanish government , which has been one of the most vociferous European critics of Israel’s Gaza offensive , has welcomed the plan and urged both sides to commit to ending the violence. “ Spain calls for every negotiating effort to end the war and reiterates its demand for a permanent ceasefire , the release of all hostages, and the massive entry of humanitarian aid to halt the suffering that has already lasted too long,” the foreign ministry said in a statement on Tuesday morning. “We can’t keep silent, nor look the other way, when confronted with so much devastation, with the bombing – even of hospitals, schools and places of refuge – or with so many deaths among the civilian population, or with the famine and the forced displacement of hundreds of thousands of people – to what end?” Continue reading...

title: Royal Mail owner to rebrand thousands of Collect+ stores as it buys stake
summary: International Distribution Services to create Royal Mail Shops for collecting, sending and returning parcels Business live – latest updates Thousands of convenience stores will be branded Royal Mail Shop, after the delivery company’s new owner acquired a stake in the parcel network Collect+, in the first big deal since it was taken over by a Czech billionaire . Royal Mail owner International Distribution Services (IDS), which was taken over by Daniel Křetínský ’s EP Group in April in a £3.6bn deal, said it had bought a 49% stake in Collect+ for £43.9m, which offers access to almost 8,000 pickup points – newsagents, convenience stores, supermarkets and petrol stations.
